```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(dataRetrieval)
library(ggpmisc)
```



## Get daily Q from HPB PT

```{r}
hpb_stage_EDI <- read_csv("https://pasta.lternet.edu/package/data/eml/edi/2333/1/630f42ffb3560c3a6afd592511756c1e")

daily_Q <- hpb_stage_EDI |> 
  mutate(Date = as.Date(DateTime)) |> 
  group_by(Date) |> 
  summarise(Q_cms_PT = mean(Flow_cms, na.rm = T)) |> 
  mutate(Q_L_s_PT = Q_cms_PT * 1000, # cms to L/s
         HPB_Flow_m3_day = Q_cms_PT * 86400
         ) 


```

USGS ~ HPB

```{r}
usgs_hbp_Q <- full_join(USGS_Ref, daily_Q) 

usgs_hbp_Q_filt <- usgs_hbp_Q |> 
  filter(Date < ymd("2025-04-01")) 

usgs_hbp_Q |> 
    ggplot(aes(x = (Tinker_Flow_m3_day), y = (HPB_Flow_m3_day)))+
  geom_point()+
  #scale_y_log10()+
  stat_poly_line(method = "lm", linewidth = 2) +
  stat_poly_eq(formula = y ~ x, label.x = "left", label.y = "top", parse = TRUE,
    inherit.aes = FALSE, aes(x = Tinker_Flow_m3_day, y = HPB_Flow_m3_day,
        label = paste(..adj.rr.label.., ..p.value.label.., sep = "~~~"), size = 3)  ) +
  theme_bw()


lm_tinker <- lm(HPB_Flow_m3_day ~ Tinker_Flow_m3_day, data = usgs_hbp_Q_filt)
summary(lm_tinker)
lm_tinker

usgs_hbp_Q <- usgs_hbp_Q |> 
  mutate(HPB_Q_lm_m3_day = predict(lm_tinker, newdata = usgs_hbp_Q))


usgs_hbp_Q |> 
  filter(Date > ymd("2024-05-01")) |> 
  select(Date, HPB_Flow_m3_day, HPB_Q_lm_m3_day) |> 
  pivot_longer(-1) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = Date, y = value, col = name))+ geom_point()


```


## Get Flowmate observations

```{r}
flowmate_edi <- read_csv("https://pasta.lternet.edu/package/data/eml/edi/454/9/0e7fe16623a1ad2a67774c23ce8a29d8")

stream_flowmate <- flowmate_edi |>
filter(Reservoir == "CCR",
         Site %in% c(101, 100, 301, 300, 201, 200)) |>
  mutate(Site = ifelse(Site %in% c(101,100), 100, Site),
         Site = ifelse(Site %in% c(301,300), 300, Site),
         Site = ifelse(Site %in% c(201,200), 200, Site)
         ) |> 
  mutate(Date = as.Date(DateTime)) |>
  dplyr::select(Date, Site, Flow_cms) |>
  dplyr::rename(Q_cms_Flowmate = Flow_cms) |>
  mutate(Q_L_s_Flowmate = Q_cms_Flowmate * 1000,
         Q_m3_day_flowmate = Q_cms_Flowmate * 86400) |>
  select(Date, Site, Q_m3_day_flowmate)


hpb_flowmate <- stream_flowmate |> filter(Site == 100 )

```


## Get stream chem

```{r}
chem_EDI <- read_csv("https://pasta.lternet.edu/package/data/eml/edi/199/13/3f09a3d23b7b5dd32ed7d28e9bc1b081")


hpb_chem <- chem_EDI |> 
  mutate(Date = as.Date(DateTime)) |> 
  filter(Reservoir == "CCR",
         Site %in% c(101, 100)) |>
  select(Reservoir, Site, Date, Depth_m, Rep, DOC_mgL, DN_mgL, NO3NO2_ugL, NH4_ugL, SRP_ugL, TN_ugL, TP_ugL) |> 
  group_by(Date) |> 
  summarise(across(c(DOC_mgL, DN_mgL, NO3NO2_ugL, NH4_ugL, SRP_ugL, TN_ugL, TP_ugL), mean, na.rm = TRUE)) |> 
  mutate(DON_mgL = DN_mgL - ((NO3NO2_ugL + NH4_ugL)/1000)) |> 
  #make all mg/L and drop P for now
  mutate(NO3_mgL = NO3NO2_ugL / 1000,
         NH4_mgL = NH4_ugL/1000,
         TN_mgL = TN_ugL/1000) |> 
  #round to 3 decimals 
  pivot_longer(-1) |> 
  mutate(value = round(value, 3)) |> 
  pivot_wider(names_from = name, values_from = value) |> 
  select(Date, DOC_mgL, DON_mgL, NO3_mgL, NH4_mgL)
  #select(Date, DOC_mgL, DON_mgL, NO3_mgL, NH4_mgL, DN_mgL, TN_mgL)


stream_chem <- chem_EDI |> 
  mutate(Date = as.Date(DateTime)) |> 
  filter(Reservoir == "CCR",
         Site %in% c(101, 100, 301, 300, 201, 200)) |>
  mutate(Site = ifelse(Site %in% c(101,100), 100, Site),
         Site = ifelse(Site %in% c(301,300), 300, Site),
         Site = ifelse(Site %in% c(201,200), 200, Site)
         ) |> 
  select(Reservoir, Site, Date, Depth_m, Rep, DOC_mgL, DN_mgL, NO3NO2_ugL, NH4_ugL, SRP_ugL, TN_ugL, TP_ugL) |> 
  group_by(Date, Site) |> 
  summarise(across(c(DOC_mgL, DN_mgL, NO3NO2_ugL, NH4_ugL, SRP_ugL, TN_ugL, TP_ugL), mean, na.rm = TRUE)) |> 
  mutate(DON_mgL = DN_mgL - ((NO3NO2_ugL + NH4_ugL)/1000)) |> 
  #make all mg/L and drop P for now
  mutate(NO3_mgL = NO3NO2_ugL / 1000,
         NH4_mgL = NH4_ugL/1000,
         TN_mgL = TN_ugL/1000) |> 
  #round to 3 decimals 
  pivot_longer(-c(1:2)) |> 
  mutate(value = round(value, 3)) |> 
  pivot_wider(names_from = name, values_from = value) |> 
  select(Date, Site, DOC_mgL, DON_mgL, NO3_mgL, NH4_mgL)
  #select(Date, DOC_mgL, DON_mgL, NO3_mgL, NH4_mgL, DN_mgL, TN_mgL)



```


New MODIS code

```{r}
library(MODISTools)
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)

ccrws_lat <- 37.384756
ccrws_long <- -79.971753

# Define a bounding box buffer (in km) around your watershed center
# Adjust km_ab and km_lr to cover your watershed extent
lai_raw <- MODISTools::mt_subset(
  product = "MCD15A2H",
  lat = ccrws_lat,
  lon = ccrws_long,
  band = c("Lai_500m", "FparLai_QC"),
  start = as_date("2020-01-01"),
  end = Sys.Date(),
  site_name = "HPB",
  km_ab = 10,       # km above/below center (north/south)
  km_lr = 10,       # km left/right of center (east/west)
  progress = FALSE
)


lai_avg <- lai_raw |>
  mutate(
    scale = ifelse(band == "FparLai_QC", 1, scale),
    scale = as.numeric(scale),
    value = scale * value,
    datetime = as_date(calendar_date)
  ) |>
  select(band, value, datetime, pixel) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = band, values_from = value) |>
  filter(FparLai_QC == 0) |>                    # keep only good quality pixels
  group_by(datetime) |>
  summarise(
    observation = mean(Lai_500m, na.rm = TRUE),  # average across all pixels
    n_pixels = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(variable = "lai")



```


make lai map

```{r}
lai_spatial <- lai_raw |>
  mutate(
    scale = ifelse(band == "FparLai_QC", 1, scale),
    scale = as.numeric(scale),
    value = scale * value,
    datetime = as_date(calendar_date)
  ) |>
  select(band, value, datetime, pixel, latitude, longitude) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = band, values_from = value) |>
  filter(FparLai_QC == 0) |>
  rename(lai = Lai_500m)

unique(lai_spatial$datetime)

# Example: map LAI for a single date
library(sf)

# Reconstruct pixel centers in sinusoidal projection
pixel_coords <- lai_raw |>
  select(pixel, ncols, nrows, xllcorner, yllcorner, cellsize) |>
  distinct() |>
  mutate(across(c(ncols, nrows, xllcorner, yllcorner, cellsize), as.numeric)) |>
  mutate(
    col = (pixel - 1) %% ncols,
    row = (pixel - 1) %/% ncols,
    x_sin = xllcorner + col * cellsize + cellsize / 2,
    y_sin = yllcorner + (nrows - row - 1) * cellsize + cellsize / 2
  ) |>
  select(pixel, x_sin, y_sin)

# Convert to sf and reproject to WGS84
pixel_coords_wgs84 <- pixel_coords |>
  st_as_sf(coords = c("x_sin", "y_sin"), crs = "+proj=sinu +R=6371007.181 +nadgrids=@null +wktext") |>
  st_transform(crs = 4326) |>
  mutate(
    lon = st_coordinates(geometry)[, 1],
    lat = st_coordinates(geometry)[, 2]
  ) |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  select(pixel, lat, lon)

# Join back
lai_spatial <- lai_spatial |>
  left_join(pixel_coords_wgs84, by = "pixel")

# Map
lai_spatial |>
  filter(datetime == as_date("2020-07-11")) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = lon, y = lat, fill = lai)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "LAI", na.value = "grey80") +
  coord_equal() +
  theme_minimal()

# option 1 - geom_raster (fastest, best for regular grids)
lai_spatial |>
  filter(datetime == as_date("2020-07-11")) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = lon, y = lat, fill = lai)) +
  geom_raster() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "LAI", na.value = "grey80") +
  theme_minimal()

```



















##join data together

```{r}

df_join <- full_join(daily_Q, hpb_flowmate, by = "Date") |> 
  full_join(lai, by = "Date") |> 
  full_join(hpb_chem, by = "Date") |> 
  arrange(Date) |> 
  filter(Date >= ymd("2020-01-01"))


write.csv(df_join, "./TargetData_2020_2025.csv", row.names = F)


```
